title: Canonical base change for a pullback presentation
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] whose canonical tensor-pullback adjunction units [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] at structure modules are invertible after every base change. Let $E$ on $X$ and $N$ on $T$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], let $g:T\to S$, and suppose $q^*E\cong p^*N$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For every $h:T\prime\to T$, in the iterated cartesian square with $p:X_T\to T$, $v:X_T\times_T T\prime\to X_T$ and $p\prime:X_T\times_T T\prime\to T\prime$, both canonical adjoint-defined module base-change maps [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] $h^*p_*q^*E\to p\prime_*v^*q^*E$ and $h^*p_*q^*(E^\vee)\to p\prime_*v^*q^*(E^\vee)$ are invertible.

theorem picard_pullback_base_change {X S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (N : T.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ≅
      (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N)) :
    ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T),
      IsIso (Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
        pullback.condition ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E)) ∧
      IsIso (Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
        pullback.condition
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj (Modules.dual E)))
